alana (eng-ml): quick sync 
ran an int6 vs int8 sweep on orthos11b-2026-09 using replayed customer slices. have numbers and a hybrid routing proposal. TL;DR: int6 saves a lot, small avg quality loss, but some long-edit/code slices tolerate int8 only. need a short canary + GTN default rec.

tariq (ml): drop the scorecard and any concentrated regressions pls.

alana (eng-ml): pasting compact scorecard from 6k sampled requests + eval slices:
```
model: orthos11b-2026-09
variants: int8, int6
latency p50/p95 (ms): int8 44/112, int6 47/148
tokens/sec: int8 220, int6 260
quality (QA EM / long-edit EM): int8 89.6 / 86.2, int6 88.9 / 84.3
approx token cost per 1k: int8 $0.0014, int6 $0.00092
notes: int6 ~34% cheaper than int8; average QA drop ~0.7 EM; long-edit/document-rewrite slice ~1.9 EM drop and p95 tail +35% there
```

marco (prod): that cost delta is tempting. any>2 EM on any slice?

tariq (ml): no >2 EM overall but long-edit is close (~1.9). code-gen multi-file shows 1.6 EM. short chat and FAQ within 0.3 EM. rerank stable.

vic (gtn): product question 
can we safely make int6 the default for new GTN tenants if we add route-level controls?

alana (eng-ml): my operational read: prefer conservative new-tenant default = int8. allow int6 as "eco" opt-in for chat-first routes. however, hybrid routing looks promising: start request on int6, if token count >512 or route annotated as long-edit, shift to int8 for remaining tokens. simulation looked favorable (replay sim attached).

marco (prod): hybrid sounds complex UX-wise. customers might be confused by switching mid-request. Do we have data that hybrid preserves quality but keeps cost low?

tariq (ml): ran a replay sim on 120k requests comparing three policies: always-int8, always-int6, hybrid (int6 then int8 at token-512). results (summary):
- cost delta vs int8: int6 -34%, hybrid -21%
- long-edit EM loss vs int8: int6 -1.9, hybrid -0.5
- p95 latency: int6 higher tail, hybrid between int8/int6
so hybrid recovers most quality for long edits while keeping majority of cost benefit.

alana (eng-ml): operational checklist I'm proposing:
- canary: 48h at 20% traffic, stratified (chat 60%, long-edit 25%, code-gen 15%)
- probes: 200 chat prompts, 75 long-edit, 40 code-gen; cadence 5m
- rollout policy: default mapping for new GTN tenants = int8; offer per-route toggle quality-tier {fidelity:int8, eco:int6, hybrid:int6->int8} where hybrid is recommended for mixed workloads
- auto-fallback: if probe EM delta >1.0 sustained 20m OR error rate rises >0.5% -> rollback for affected route to int8
- extra: enable per-request detection (prompt-length OR route tag) to trigger hybrid switch

ops-bot: canary-rule created id=orthos-c1, start=2026-09-14T07:00:00Z, traffic=20%, fallback=int8, alert-channel=#eng-ml-ops

marco (prod): also require customer-facing advisory: default=int8, eco=int6 opt-in, hybrid=recommended for mixed traffic. when customer flips to eco/hybrid, show estimated token savings + 10 sample diffs.

tariq (ml): i'll own probe sets and replay sim verification. will post 6h and 24h snapshots during canary. also suggest adding a tiny synthetic "attention-stress" prompt set (10 prompts) to catch kernel tail cases.

alana (eng-ml): engineering follow-ups before canary: 1) validate KV-prefix warmstart reduces p95 on long-edit by sim 2) add hybrid switch path in runtime (fast path detection + compatible kernel switch) 3) add metric for per-request quant switch count to detect oscillations

vic (gtn): i'll draft GTN onboarding copy and the per-route UX language. want to include a short recommended mapping for common templates (chat/faq -> eco/hybrid; code-gen/legal -> fidelity).

marco (prod): +1 to human review for code-gen/long-edit samples every 2h during canary. also add rollback automation: if probe EM delta >1.5 for 30m, auto-zero the canary and notify #product #gtn #support.

tariq (ml): noted. will instrument alert thresholds on dashboard.

alana (eng-ml): decision: start canary now per ops-bot. if 24h snapshot shows hybrid keeping probe EM delta <0.6 and cost ~-20% vs int8, propose updating GTN new-tenant default to hybrid for mixed workloads and int6-only for chat-first self-serve opt-ins.

vic (gtn): will wait for 24h snapshot before publishing advisory.

marco (prod): thanks team. please keep support looped for opt-in guidance.

alana (eng-ml): closing thread 44d will post canary links & replay sim output here.
